feeds.title: Gluten-Free Globetrotter
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Erin Smith. Living with celiac disease since 1981 and eating gluten-free long before it was 'trendy', I have a unique perspective of growing up in the gluten-free community. This blog is Your ultimate resource for gluten-free travel.

feeds.title: Gluten Free Alchemist » Travel
feeds.description: Gluten free travel : Advice, tips, destinations, gluten free eating guides & more to help you find confidence & information to live your gluten free & Coeliac life without limits. I'm Kate - a gluten free recipe creator, traveller, photographer and blogger, living in the beautiful Garden of England - Kent, with my ever-patient husband and Coeliac daughter.

feeds.title: Gluten Free Travel Girl
feeds.description: My name is Ali and I am 100% gluten free and 100% traveler. Realizing I had to eat gluten free (to help chronic migraines) didn't slow down my passion for food or travel - it only made it stronger. Now, I'm on a new adventure trying to find the best GF food on my travels and help anyone I can along the way.

feeds.title: Celiac Travel Pack
feeds.description: Traveling with Celiac can be stressful but it doesn't have to be! I've been traveling with Celiac for more than 10 years and I'll share my tips, itineraries, and restaurant recommendations with you.

feeds.title: Gluten Free Adventures
feeds.description: Gluten Free Adventures is a blog about gluten-free travel around the world that aims to share experiences, anecdotes and tips to encourage other celiacs to continue discovering new destinations full of gluten-free restaurants, gluten-free bakeries, gluten-free ice-cream parlours and much more. My name is Santi and In 2001, I was diagnosed with celiac disease, finally. Also, I'm lactose intolerant, my fish allergy literally kills me, and so do some fruits. Traveling gluten-free has become my biggest hobby and I created Gluten Free Adventures for this reason.

feeds.title: Travel Gluten Free Podcast Blog
feeds.description: Tips for finding gluten-free foods, gluten free travel guides, how to find gluten free restaurants, and information on where to go and what to do when you're traveling gluten-free. Enjoy your gluten-free lifestyle with Travel Gluten Free Podcast.

feeds.title: Wheatless Wanderlust » Gluten Free Travel
feeds.description: We're Matt and Alysha, the two endlessly curious gluten free foodies behind Wheatless Wanderlust. We believe that travel is about learning, discovery, and connection. We'll help you become an active participant when you travel - as opposed to an observer - by helping you find ways to connect with locals through cooking classes, walking tours, and more.

feeds.title: Gluten Interrupted Blog
feeds.description: Gluten Interrupted is a coeliac's guide to life, based in Edinburgh. Gluten Interrupted is me, Rebecca. I was diagnosed with Coeliac Disease in 2014 and have traveled to many places always relying on other people's blogs and the 'gluten free' search on Trip Advisor. I live in Edinburgh, the gluten free capital of the UK and travel frequently (when I can) to update the knowledge base of what's actually good for other adventurous coeliacs.

feeds.title: Gluten Free Horizons
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Francesca, a gluten free foodie and travel addict stumbling my way through life. This blog will be full of reviews, ramblings and possibly ranting.

feeds.title: Gluten Free Travel
feeds.description: This blog is about gluten-free traveling, and will contain first-hand restaurant recommendations. My name is Ifat and I have been gluten-free since 2016. There is a lot to say about the gluten-free life, and I will, but not now. This is what you need to know for now: There are several levels of strictness when it comes to a gluten-free diet, and this blog will fit mine.

feeds.title: The Gluten Free Cheerleader
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Kathryn, a gluten free blogger based just outside of Glasgow, Scotland. I was diagnosed with Coeliac Disease in 2012 and since then have made it my mission to find the best places to eat from around the world and share them with everyone.

feeds.title: Rachel Wanders Blog
feeds.description: Rachel Wanders is a gluten-free blog created to help inspire your gluten-free foodie desires across the globe. Discover new adventures with Rachel Wanders. Originally from Iowa, but currently residing in Colorado Springs, CO, Rachel is inspired by anything and everything that has to do with the world we live in. What is better than traveling and experiencing new places? Traveling and experiencing new places whilst EATING.
